content.short: Indian investors use CoinDCX for rupee spot trading, perpetual futures and crypto SIPs that start at 100 rupees.
content.description: CoinDCX serves Indian investors with rupee deposits and a large list of spot markets. Futures traders get perpetual contracts on BTC, ETH and other assets. For long-term buyers, crypto SIPs automate recurring purchases starting at 100 rupees. A built-in Web3 mode reaches tokens that are not listed on the main exchange. The company publishes Proof of Reserves attestations every quarter. The exchange reports around 20 million registered users.
content.meta: Indian crypto exchange with rupee trading, perpetual futures, SIPs and quarterly proof of reserves. Explore CoinDCX on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
